narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The middle triangle is upside down, so it must be a different shape.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Turning a triangle over does not change the length of its sides.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We need its sides, not which way up it sits.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Two equal halves around a sixty degree angle make an equilateral triangle.
<bookmark mark='two'/>The middle triangle is built from the third sides of the corners.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. An equilateral triangle has sides of six centimetres. How long is each side of the small triangles?
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the flag; two lines appear: halves around a 60° angle make an equilateral corner triangle; the middle triangle uses the three third sides; then a new triangle with side 6 cm and an empty box
